description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

description.zh: 灰度规则，如果是Beta灰度，此处是灰度的客户端的ip，使用逗号分隔；如果是标签灰度，此处是 标签名=标签值，多个标签值使用逗号分隔
description.en: The canary release rule. For a beta release, you can specify one or more client IP addresses for this parameter. You must separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). For a tag-based canary release, the value is in the format of Tag name=Tag value. You must separate multiple tag values with commas (,).

description.zh: 灰度类型，支持Beta灰度(根据IP灰度)和标签灰度
description.en: The canary release type. Beta release (IP address-based canary release) and tag-based canary release are supported.
The group name. Default value: DEFAULT\_GROUP.
The namespace ID. Default value: public.

description.zh: 操作类型，Create（创建新的灰度配置），Update（更新存在的灰度配置）
description.en: The operation type. Valid values: Create (create a canary release configuration) and Update (update an existing canary release configuration).
The extended request parameter in the JSON format.
Specifies whether to stop the canary release.
